definition: Recurrent throbbing headache, often one-sided, with nausea and light sensitivity. About three times more common in women. Not ‘just a headache’.
Clouding of the eye’s lens, usually with age. The fix, swapping in an artificial lens, is one of the most common operations in Australia.
Trouble getting to sleep or staying asleep despite the chance to. First-line treatment is CBT for insomnia, not sleeping pills. World Sleep Day.
Tendency to repeated unprovoked seizures. Seizure first aid: time it, protect the head, nothing in the mouth, recovery position once it stops. Purple Day.
